Why bytes, not a deserialised event
The archive's product is the payload that was published. A re-encoding would make an integrity check verify the re-encoding rather than the evidence.

What step 8 is not
LoggingAuditSink logs the record and discards it. S3 Parquet, the signed manifest and Object Lock are Phase 3, so no evidence claim rests on this path yet.
